text.name: Azelf

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Downer Material
abilities.text: If you have Uxie and Mesprit in play, the attack cost of each of your opponent's Basic Pokémon's attacks is {Colorless} more. You can't use more than 1 Downer Material Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Bind Pulse
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't attach any Special Energy cards from his or her hand to any of his or her Pokémon.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Willpower," it sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

attacks.name: Trash Bolt
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card from your hand. (If you can't discard a card from your hand, this attack does nothing.)

text.name: Mesprit

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Upper Material
abilities.text: If you have Uxie and Azelf in play, the Retreat Cost for each Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf (both yours and your opponent's) is 0.

attacks.name: Teleportation Burst
attacks.text: You may switch Mesprit with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Emotion," it taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

attacks.name: Tail Revenge
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the number of Magikarp in your discard pile.

attacks.name: Wreak Havoc
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Dragon Beat
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card from each of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.name: Azelf

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Time Walk
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Azelf from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at all of your face-down Prize cards. If you do, you may choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then, choose 1 card in your hand and put it as a Prize card face down.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Willpower," it sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

text.name: Uxie

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Uxie from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Restore
attacks.text: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Knowledge," it is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Flash Bite
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Crobat G from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Toxic Fang
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Overeager
abilities.text: If Sableye is your Active Pokémon at the beginning of the game, you go first. (If each player's Active Pokémon has the Overeager Poké-Body, this power does nothing.)

attacks.name: Impersonate
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card and discard it. Shuffle your deck afterward. Then, use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack.

attacks.name: Overconfident
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Sableye, this attack's base damage is 40.

text.name: Unown Q

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: QUICK
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Unown Q is on your Bench, you may discard all cards attached to Unown Q and attach Unown Q to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. As long as Unown Q is attached to a Pokémon, you pay {Colorless} less to retreat that Pokémon.

text.flavor: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whose language of UNOWN came first.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Honey
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Combee from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Alert
attacks.text: Draw a card. Then, you may switch Combee with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Sea Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, draw a card.

text.flavor: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

text.name: Super Scoop Up
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

text.name: Expert Belt
effect: The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP and that Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). When the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 1 more Prize card.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool rule
rules.text: Attach Expert Belt to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

text.name: Bebe's Search
effect: Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Cyclone Energy
effect: Cyclone Energy provides {Colorless} Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Benched Pokémon to switch.

text.name: Warp Energy
effect: Warp Energy provides {Colorless} Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.name: Pokémon Collector
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Felicity's Drawing
effect: Discard up to 2 cards from your hand. If you discard 1 card, draw 3 cards. If you discard 2 cards, draw 4 cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Broken Time-Space
effect: Each player may evolve a Pokémon that he or she just played or evolved during that turn.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Bright Look
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put Luxray GL LV.X from your hand onto your Active Luxray GL, you may switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flash Impact
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your Pokémon, and don't apply Weakness and Resistance to this damage.

rules.text: Put this card onto your Active Luxray GL. Luxray GL LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

text.name: Pokémon Rescue
effect: Search your discard pile for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-105 Poké Turn

text.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-105 Poké Turn
effect: Return 1 of your Pokémon SP and all cards attached to it to your hand.

text.name: Cynthia's Feelings
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, draw 4 more cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: VS Seeker
effect: Search your discard pile for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.
